summary: @servicetitan/microfront preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which fetches the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then invokes that freshly-downloaded interpreter (via execFileSync) to run math_init.js — a 727KB sibling file whose entire body is a shuffled numeric/string constant array indexed through a rotator function (WV8StW push/shift), with all identifiers randomized. The payload runs under Bun rather than Node, so it is not reachable through the package's Node module graph, and its behavior cannot be determined from the obfuscated source. The advertised purpose is a microfrontend integration library, which does not require an alternate language runtime or install-time code execution. The package claims the @servicetitan npm scope and lists a github.com/servicetitan/playground.git repository, using that scope association as cover for the dropper. Installing the package causes the obfuscated Bun payload to execute on the installer's machine with the user's privileges before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
